tool_args.rationale: The branch probe added a low-gradient row, which confirms the smooth baseline but does not test siphon activation. The trajectory batch is the only remaining relevant probe for obtaining observations that could distinguish the two mechanisms.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Fits all six rows to rounding precision, but those rows cannot test whether an additional sink activates outside the observed range.
The observed gradients never exceed 2.20, below the recalled onset range of 2.50–2.68. The threshold and post-onset loss cannot be fitted from these rows.
The auxiliary reading would not distinguish smooth attenuation from a thresholded loss.
